11.
Section  218  of  the  principal  enactment  is  hereby
repealed and the following section substituted therefor:—

“Penalty  for
218.    A  person  who  contravenes  the
provisions of section 99 shall be guilty of an

offence and shall on conviction be liable to a
certificate  of
fine not less than twenty five thousand rupees
and not exceeding fifty thousand rupees or to
imprisonment  for  a  term  not  exceeding  one
month or to both such fine and imprisonment.”.
